question: Tampilkan per wilayah pelanggan: total omset, jumlah tiket, dan rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket.
sql: SELECT omset_agg.wilayah, omset_agg.total_omset, tiket_agg.jumlah_tiket, round(tiket_agg.rata_rata_resolusi, 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.attributes['region']) AS omset_agg LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_tiket, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE 1 GROUP BY c.attributes['region']) AS tiket_agg ON omset_agg.wilayah = tiket_agg.wilayah

sql: SELECT omset_agg.tim, omset_agg.jumlah_deal_won, aktivitas_agg.jumlah_demo, round(aktivitas_agg.rata_rata_durasi, 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM (SELECT r.team AS tim, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team) AS omset_agg LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.team AS tim, count() AS jumlah_demo, avg(a.duration_minutes) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' GROUP BY r.team) AS aktivitas_agg ON omset_agg.tim = aktivitas_agg.tim

question: per tim sales, nilai pipeline vs jumlah aktivitas call 30 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT omset_agg.tim, omset_agg.total_pipeline, aktivitas_agg.jumlah_call FROM (SELECT r.team AS tim, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team) AS omset_agg LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.team AS tim, count() AS jumlah_call FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY r.team) AS aktivitas_agg ON omset_agg.tim = aktivitas_agg.tim

question: Per segmen pelanggan: jumlah aktivitas dan jumlah tiket.
sql: SELECT aktivitas_agg.segmen, aktivitas_agg.jumlah_aktivitas, tiket_agg.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segmen, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE 1 GROUP BY c.segment) AS aktivitas_agg INNER JOIN (SELECT c.segment AS segmen, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE 1 GROUP BY c.segment) AS tiket_agg ON aktivitas_agg.segmen = tiket_agg.segmen

question: rekap per industri: jumlah aktivitas negatif dan jumlah tiket urgent
sql: SELECT aktivitas_agg.industri, aktivitas_agg.jumlah_negatif, tiket_agg.jumlah_urgent FROM (SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' GROUP BY c.attributes['industry']) AS aktivitas_agg INNER JOIN (SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c.attributes['industry']) AS tiket_agg ON aktivitas_agg.industri = tiket_agg.industri

question: Pelanggan mana yang total omsetnya di atas 1 juta dan punya lebih dari 2 tiket? Tampilkan id, nama, omset, dan jumlah tiket.

question: customer yg total omsetnya di atas 800 ribu dan punya minimal 1 tiket urgent, siapa aja? sertakan kedua angkanya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, omset_agg.total_omset, tiket_agg.jumlah_tiket_urgent FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS omset_agg ON c.customer_id = omset_agg.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tiket_agg ON c.customer_id = tiket_agg.customer_id WHERE omset_agg.total_omset > 800000 AND tiket_agg.jumlah_tiket_urgent >= 1

question: Siapa pelanggan yang punya nilai pipeline lebih dari 500 ribu dan lebih dari 1 tiket terbuka?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, omset_agg.total_pipeline, tiket_agg.jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS omset_agg ON c.customer_id = omset_agg.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tiket_agg ON c.customer_id = tiket_agg.customer_id WHERE omset_agg.total_pipeline > 500000 AND tiket_agg.jumlah_tiket_terbuka > 1

question: pelanggan dgn omset diatas 1 juta tapi rata2 resolusi tiketnya lebih dari 100 jam, tampilkan id, nama, dan kedua nilai (rata2 dibulatkan)
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, omset_agg.total_omset, round(tiket_agg.rata_rata_resolusi, 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS omset_agg ON c.customer_id = omset_agg.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_resolusi FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE 1 GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS tiket_agg ON c.customer_id = tiket_agg.customer_id WHERE omset_agg.total_omset > 1000000 AND tiket_agg.rata_rata_resolusi > 100

question: Berapa jumlah pelanggan yang omsetnya melebihi 1,5 juta sekaligus punya lebih dari 3 tiket?

question: hitung pelanggan Enterprise yg omset > 1 juta dan punya tiket high atau urgent lebih dari 1, per tier

question: Tampilkan id dan nama pelanggan dengan lebih dari 5 aktivitas dan lebih dari 1 tiket terbuka, plus kedua jumlahnya.

question: customer yg punya lebih dari 3 deal won dan lebih dari 8 aktivitas, siapa aja (id, nama, jumlah deal won, jumlah aktivitas)
